cards.name: Colour
cards.subtitle: Every colour role across four themes, each with the contrast ratio it was measured at and the criterion it was measured against, over the seven surfaces they are measured against.

cards.name: Typography
cards.subtitle: One scale of a perfect fourth, two scripts, a measured multiplier for Bangla and a floor it never goes below.

cards.name: Space and shape
cards.subtitle: A 4 px scale in ten steps, and four radii. Everything in the system sits on one of them.

cards.name: Motion
cards.subtitle: Two durations and three easing curves. Things that move may overshoot; things that only change colour never do.

cards.name: The marks
cards.subtitle: The mark in two weights, drawn in currentColor so it takes whatever theme it lands in.

cards.name: Accessibility
cards.subtitle: Target sizes with the guidance each one comes from, the anatomy of the focus ring, and what happens in forced colours — the mode where the operating system replaces every colour with its own.

cards.name: Button
cards.subtitle: Four kinds, two sizes and an icon-only form, each with a label that says what will happen.

cards.name: Input
cards.subtitle: A label, an optional hint, and an error that says what happened and then what to do next.

cards.name: Select
cards.subtitle: A native select with a drawn arrow, so the arrow follows the theme instead of the operating system.

cards.name: Checkbox and radio
cards.subtitle: Native controls at 24 px, wrapped in a label so the words are part of the target.

cards.name: Textarea
cards.subtitle: You can drag it taller but never wider, so the line length stays comfortable to read.

cards.name: Badge
cards.subtitle: Five meanings, each carrying a glyph and a word so the colour is the third signal and never the only one.

cards.name: Card
cards.subtitle: A surface a step brighter than the page, with a shadow in the light theme and none in the dark ones.

cards.name: Alert
cards.subtitle: Four kinds. Each says what happened, then what happens next, and never blames the reader.

cards.name: Dialog
cards.subtitle: A real dialog element over a dimmed backdrop, with the destructive action named rather than called OK.

cards.name: Table
cards.subtitle: Row headers, a caption saying what the numbers are, and a sideways scroll when the table is wider than the space.

cards.name: Tabs
cards.subtitle: The selected tab is bold, underlined and marked with aria-selected. Three signals, one of which is a colour.

cards.name: Nav
cards.subtitle: Vertical and horizontal. The current item carries a bar, a heavier weight and aria-current.

cards.name: Breadcrumb
cards.subtitle: The last item is not a link, because you are already on it.

cards.name: Toast
cards.subtitle: A short message with a dismiss button that has a name of its own, not only a cross.

cards.name: Empty state
cards.subtitle: Says what is missing, and then exactly what to do about it.

cards.name: Code block
cards.subtitle: Aninda Mono, a horizontal scroll rather than a wrap, and a copy button that says what it copies.

cards.name: Sign in
cards.subtitle: One card, two fields, and an option for someone who has no password.

cards.name: Settings
cards.subtitle: Grouped in fieldsets, with the destructive action kept apart and named.

cards.name: Dashboard
cards.subtitle: Four figures, one table, and a note saying where the numbers came from.

cards.name: Docs page
cards.subtitle: Breadcrumb, page navigation and prose held to a readable line length.

cards.name: Landing
cards.subtitle: A claim, the reason to believe it, and two ways forward.

cards.name: Pricing
cards.subtitle: Three plans, with the recommended one marked by a badge and a word.

cards.name: Not found
cards.subtitle: Says the page is missing, then offers the pages most people were looking for.

cards.name: Form with validation
cards.subtitle: A summary at the top, an error under each field, and nothing lost.
